This allows for the sharing and adaptation of the datasets for any purpose, provided that the appropriate credit is given."

redistributed.note: Unmodified copies of the raw files above (same SHA-256), committed under CC BY 4.0 with secom/ATTRIBUTION.md. Paths are relative to data/: the three files are committed in data/secom/; secom.zip is the downloaded archive, kept only in the git-ignored data/raw/secom/.

wm811k.title: WM-811K wafer maps (MIR Lab, National Taiwan University)
wm811k.citation: Wu, M.-J., Jang, J.-S. R. and Chen, J.-L. (2015). Wafer map failure pattern recognition and similarity ranking for large-scale data sets. IEEE Transactions on Semiconductor Manufacturing, 28(1), 1-12.
wm811k.licence: Kaggle mirror qingyi/wm811k-wafer-map (dataset id 14180) lists the licence CC0-1.0 in its metadata (retrieved 2026-10-14). That licence was set by the Kaggle uploader, not by the original authors (MIR Lab); the original release states no licence we could retrieve (http://mirlab.org/dataSet/public/ returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-14). We therefore treat it as a research dataset: raw data is never redistributed, only a small derived demo subset with attribution.
